notes: Company background: mid-market CX platform provider powering 3rd-party contact centers. heavy focus on agent productivity metrics (AHT, handle time).
Primary ask: streaming, context-aware suggestions delivered to agent UI within tight SLOs (<150ms 95th ideally).
Secondary: automated ticket summaries after call, multi-turn context preservation, and safe tool-calling to update CRM and open tickets.
Quoted from head of product: "If suggestion latency slips during spikes, agents will ignore it — reliability beats model hallucinations."
POC constraints: cannot ship any customer PII outside VPC during evaluation; need encrypted KV cache and audit hooks for every suggestion call.
Cost sensitivity: interested in batching/quantization recommendations from Redwood Optimize — wants cost per suggestion < $0.002 at scale.
Guardrails: mandatory redaction patterns, intent classifiers to gate tool-calls (no outbound billing changes without human confirmation).
Integration notes: uses Talkdesk for telephony, Salesforce as CRM, homegrown agent UI built on React — will use Redwood streaming to push suggestions to UI websockets.
Success metrics for POC: suggestion acceptance rate >= 60% OR AHT reduction >= 12% AND summary accuracy F1 >= 0.82 on labeled prompts.
